text:
raj_infra: starting scheduled BMC firmware rollout to us-west2 racks at 03:00 UTC. will stagger by rack.
deploy-bot: job 4532 kicked off (bmc-fw v2.14 -> v2.15).
raj_infra: heads up — rack-r8 nodes not reporting back after the update. oobctl shows 'partial-update' for 10/48.
maria_ops: console? can you query state?
raj_infra: ran `oobctl get-state rack-r8` — most BMCs returned `UPDATE_PENDING` then dropped to `NO_RESPONSE`. GPU hosts themselves show kernel panic on next boot. snippet: 
```
$ oobctl get-state --rack rack-r8
node-01: PARTIAL_UPDATE
node-02: NO_RESPONSE
node-03: PARTIAL_UPDATE
...
```
alex_g: interesting — logs show a secure-boot flag flip during the apply phase (`secure_boot: toggled -> disabled`). that shouldn't happen in this image.
jordan_oncall: are we seeing any certificate errors on the OOB controller side? last time cert expiry caused the controller to reject post-update validation.
raj_infra: yes, BMC TLS handshake failing intermittently: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority`. looks like the new fw rotates the onboard certs and our CA pinning on the oob-proxy rejects it.
maria_ops: if the BMC certs rotate and secure boot gets toggled off, the hosts drop to initramfs because kernel modules (nv) are blocked by shim. GPU drivers failing -> nodes land in maintenance state.
alex_g: quick check: `journalctl -b -1 | grep -i shim` on one recovered node shows shim rejection.
jordan_oncall: impact: ~10 GPU hosts in rack-r8 unusable -> dedicated pool capacity down ~12%. need rollback plan, customers on dedicated committed pools might be affected.
raj_infra: immediate plan: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) identify nodes with PARTIAL_UPDATE and power-cycle BMCs to force rollback attempt, 3) if BMC won't roll back, schedule manual reflash next maintenance window, 4) open client comms if SLA at risk.
maria_ops: try remote toggle to re-enable secure boot first? but if certs rotated, enabling may fail because keys missing. still worth a shot on nodes reporting PARTIAL_UPDATE.
raj_infra: running command now: 
```
# try toggle back and request a status refresh
oobctl set-secure-boot --rack rack-r8 --state enabled --force && oobctl refresh --rack rack-r8
```
alex_g: output from node-03: `error: unable to set secure-boot: missing db keys (ERR_KEY_MISSING)`. so we can't re-enable without pushing signing keys.
jordan_oncall: ok, escalate to firmware vendor for signed key bundle. meanwhile mark nodes in cluster as drained and move workloads: `k8sctl cordon` + migrate evictions.
maria_ops: done for the 10 nodes. migration started, noticing longer job churn on inference queues.
sysbot: incident created — INC-2026-0318-78: "BMC fw partial update -> secure-boot/ca rotation causing GPU hosts offline". assigned to eng-infra.
raj_infra: opened SR with vendor (SR-7892) with logs and evidence of cert rotation. ETA for signed bundle TBD.
alex_g: we should also check the update artifact — looks like v2.15 includes an optional cert rotation step not flagged in release notes. filing a docs/incident note.
jordan_oncall: low-latency customers on dedicated instances: recommend temporary capacity bump from spare pool or region failover. cost note: shifting about 30% of rack-r8 load to us-west1 will incur cross-region egress on some batches.
maria_ops: raised a cost exception with finance for emergency capacity move.
raj_infra: short-term remediation steps summary: pause rollout, cordon/drain affected nodes, open vendor SR, attempt safe power cycle to trigger automatic rollback (only for BMCs that still accept commands), plan manual reflash for others.
alex_g: long-term: add pre-check to validate cert chain and secure-boot state in a dry-run before applying firmware; add a rollback verification step that checks `secure_boot` and `db_keys` post-apply.
jordan_oncall: tagging infra oncall for manual effort tomorrow 04:30 UTC for any nodes that don't auto-recover.
maria_ops: can someone post the quick diagnostic commands in the incident ticket (INC-2026-0318-78)? I'll attach migration logs.
raj_infra: done. ticket includes `oobctl get-state`, `oobctl show-cert --node`, sample kernel logs, and `k8sctl cordon/evict` lines.
sysbot: update: job 4532 paused by raj_infra at 03:12 UTC.
ajrl: thumbs up? :thumbsup:
raj_infra: updating status every 15m in thread. thanks all.
